# The calls each Kokkos part makes in `scripts/ww3-gpu.sh --ww3-gpu coast --kokkos resident`, one
# "ww_kokkos: <counter>: <n>" line of the Kokkos run's ww3_shel.out each (the *_COUNT flags).
# They do not depend on WW_KOKKOS_VA_RESIDENT, _VA_CHECK, _VA_POISON, _SRCE_STAGED, _OUTG_STAGED
# or _XYP3_TEAM, and the script skips them when a batch cap is set. A part that falls back to the
# Fortran, or a cache that never skips, writes the same bits and only these lines show it
# (docs/log/2026-10-17-mutation-audit.md). A change of the case or of a part's call pattern
# changes them: re-read them from a run, never edit one to pass.
